sentences.en: In 1996, Tom Clancy helped create Red Storm Entertainment, which developed and published many Tom Clancy video games.

sentences.en: The company was purchased by Ubisoft Entertainment years later and still legally uses the Tom Clancy name for marketing and promotional purposes.

sentences.en: A fun fact about Tom Clancy is that he is part-owner of the Baltimore Orioles and sits at the Vice Chairman of their Community Activities and Public Affairs.
